scope: Current workspace mainline: explicit personal tasks, revision-bound memory, final evidence retention, typed domain-event projection

implemented.personal_task_input: Instruction-only or explicitly selected confirmed memories; no upload required; no implicit cross-project memory borrowing
implemented.task_memory_binding: Selected IDs and exact revisions are stored with each step; changed inputs invalidate affected steps and dependent artifacts
implemented.publication_barrier: After asynchronous hydration, one bounded SQLite read transaction rechecks all document snapshots, selected memory revisions and transitive provenance; no later await before return
implemented.busy_database: Final synchronous publication check has a 50ms SQLite busy timeout and rejects export instead of reusing stale content
implemented.known_predispatch_failure: Actual answer-model dispatch is tracked; a proven pre-dispatch rejection is terminal failed, not an unknown provider result
implemented.unknown_provider_outcome: After actual model dispatch an ambiguous exception remains unknown; recovery and repeated approvals do not silently re-execute it
implemented.need_ledger: Binds literal needs to exact source ID, document, label, span and SHA; budget fallback chooses whole windows by bounded weighted literal coverage rather than prefix alone
implemented.ledger_token_cost: New detailed retention diagnostics are out-of-band metadata, not additional model messages; no extra provider call or increased input ceiling
implemented.domain_events: Explicit confirmed entities, events and typed relationships are stored in the existing private ResearchStore, with revision history, origin binding and withdrawal redaction
implemented.ui: Long tasks offer a personal-task input choice and per-step manual memory selection; completed execution is labeled as awaiting user acceptance

regressions_found_and_fixed: Withdrawal of an earlier section's memory during a later section's final asynchronous check could leak old report text
A valid saved memory larger than the request's whole-memory allowance could be marked as an unknown model outcome despite zero answer-model calls
The request journal did not recognize a host pre-dispatch failure code
New detailed need-gap messages could alter normal wire packets or displace previously feasible evidence under a tight budget

verification.generation: Synthetic local writers; real ASGI routes, task bridge, SQLite stores, request journal and concurrent mutation checks

preserved: Existing logo, demo, overall visual style and README were not edited by this increment
Default document-task request shape and immutable request identity remain compatible
Harness, Insight Schema and configured model adapters remain the execution path
not_claimed: Literal witness retention is not semantic entailment, full-document coverage or correct causal reasoning
Domain-event relationships are explicit source-bound assertions, not automatic verified causal discovery
Task step completion is not proof that the user's goal was fulfilled
The durable task graph is still a bounded user-authored plan, not unlimited autonomous dynamic replanning
Mobile confirmed memory remains intentionally project-scoped; no implicit cross-project personal-memory sharing was added
No new real-model answer-quality, billed-token or end-to-end latency A/B result was established in this increment
No production-release, physical all-copy erasure or autonomous RSI guarantee
